config.name: a1h_structured
config.description: Same as a1_structured plus contextual chunk headers (company, ticker, form, period, section) prepended to the indexed text. A1: structure-aware chunks. Children are section-bounded, paragraph-aligned, at most 200 words / 1,400 chars (inside bge's 512-token window); parents group children up to 800 words. Dense retrieval over children, as in A0, so only the chunking differs.
